module_summary: Stream width downsizer: a trip counter steps a slice index on each output handshake, muxing narrow slices of the wide input and asserting input ready on the last slice.

anchors.name: inp_data_i
anchors.why: Wide input word sliced into narrow beats by the slice counter.

anchors.name: inp_valid_i
anchors.why: Wide input valid, forwarded as output valid and enabling the slice counter.

anchors.name: inp_ready_o
anchors.why: Input ready driven by the counter trip, consuming the wide word on its last slice.

anchors.name: oup_data_o
anchors.why: Narrow output slice selected from the wide input by slice_q.

anchors.name: slice_q
anchors.why: Slice counter output indexing which narrow slice of the input is output.

anchors.name: oup_valid_o
anchors.why: Narrow output valid, a direct copy of input valid.

anchors.name: oup_ready_i
anchors.why: Narrow output ready, enabling the slice counter together with input valid.

groups.name: slice_counter
groups.description: Trip counter counting accepted narrow beats up to Ratio-1 and tripping input ready.

groups.name: slice_mux
groups.description: Part-select mux steering one narrow slice of the wide input to the output stream.
